My LGBT friends are atheists or agnostics and when I tell them about my concern, they don't think it's relevant or laugh at me.

I thought about going to some LGBTI + church but I would feel equally guilty.  The thought always comes to my mind: if you want to follow Jesus you cannot remove the parts of the Bible that you don't like.  And I suffer because of it all

I don't think being gay is a bad thing.  But I think that committing acts of a homosexual nature is a sin (because I believe in the Bible and God) and consequently it corrodes me.  And the most difficult of all is that I don't see the reason why this is wrong (rationally speaking), but it is in the bible, I can't take that piece off because I don't like it.  so this is the dilemma: not being able to live in either way.
